Pursuant to the earlier order dated 25.07.2025, learned Advocate for the Applicant and learned APP have produced the application preferred by the present Applicant in the Court of Metropolitan Magistrate, 69th Court, at Mazgaon, Mumbai for regular bail and the order passed thereon dated 29.11.2023.

sentences.text: The certified copies are taken on record and marked 'X' for identification.
2. Perusal of the application indicates that the Applicant had disclosed the order passed by the this Court on 24.08.2023 by which interim protection was granted by this Court.

It is already noted in the order dated 25.07.2025 by this Court that following the law laid down in Rukhmini Mahato v/s.
State of Jharkhand [(2017) 15 SCC 574] by the Hon'ble Supreme Court, the Applicant could not have adopted the course to appear before the Magistrate during the 60 ABA-1450-2023.doc pendency of the anticipatory bail application in this Court.

sentences.text: Learned APP pointed that what had transpired on 02.10.2023 was formal arrest pursuant to the order passed by this Court on 24.08.2023 after which the Applicant was released on interim protection by this Court.
Learned advocate for the Applicant has fairly not disputed this position.
He submits that there was no magisterial custodial remand and there was no custodial interrogation.
4. Considering the aforesaid circumstances, the observations of the Magistrate in order dated 29.11.2023 are not justified and contrary to record.

Once it was disclosed to the concerned Magistrate that the Applicant had interim protection of this Court, the Magistrate could not have proceeded to consider the application for grant of regular bail.
In that view of the matter, the order dated 29.11.2023 passed in Bail Application No. 1140/BA/2023 is set aside.

5. Learned counsel for the Applicant then urged that since charge sheet is already filed in the matter and as such investigation is complete, no purpose will be served by keeping the present application pending and same be heard.

6. Learned APP on instructions of the officer of concerned police station (who is present in the court) confirmed that charge sheet is 60 ABA-1450-2023.doc already filed and the case is already registered as C.C.No.1411/PW/2023 in concerned Court.

7. The Applicant is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with CR No.210 of 2023 registered with Nagpada polie station, Mumbai for the offences punishable under Sections 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Sections 20 and 25 of the Indian Telegraph Act 1885, and Sections 3 and 6 of Indian Wireless Telegraphy Act 1933.
It is already observed in earlier order dated 24.08.2023 that the co-applicant Salim was found to be operating an illegal telephone exchange.
A raid was conducted.
A sim box and other equipments were found.
The said co-accused named the present applicant as the person who had provided the sim box.

8. Considering the nature of allegation and the stage of investigation as informed by the learned APP, and further considering the fact that the Applicant was protected for last two years by this Court and since charge sheet is already filed, a case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.
9. The Application is allowed in terms of order dated 24.08.2023.
The Applicant is directed to attend the Trial regularly unless exempted from the concerned Trial Court.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.)
